profile.name: Ken Angelo Ardiente
profile.tagline: I build fast, reliable software from database to pixel.
profile.bio: I'm a full-stack developer who likes taking a product from a rough sketch to something people actually use. Most of my work lives at the intersection of clean APIs and interfaces that don't get in the way. When I'm not shipping features, I'm probably reading about distributed systems or tinkering with a side project that will never see daylight.

projects.title: Orbit — Team Task Manager
projects.description: A Kanban-style project management tool with real-time updates, drag-and-drop boards, and per-project analytics. Built to explore optimistic UI patterns and WebSocket state sync at scale.

projects.title: Ledger — Personal Finance Tracker
projects.description: A privacy-first budgeting app that categorizes transactions automatically and visualizes spending trends. Includes a rules engine for recurring transactions and CSV bank imports.

projects.title: Signal — API Uptime Monitor
projects.description: A lightweight uptime and latency monitor for internal APIs, with Slack alerting and a public status page generator, deployed via containers behind a load balancer.
